meta.source: hand-built from full read of DT_DialogueNodes (428 lines, 22 scenes), charm data, typewriter cards and UI widgets
meta.note: names: speaker-box names and in-text names. terms: translate these the same way every time. Edit by hand to lock spellings.

俺.role: Protagonist/narrator name-box in the opening and ending scenes; the same person as 蓮. In narration render first-person normally; the name-box label can stay 'Ren'
俺.register: Jaded deadpan slacker; clipped angry protests in the ritual (ふざけるなよ); flustered around Konoha

蓮.role: Protagonist name-box from DL5 onward (after the GM names him 蓮君)

木葉.role: Heroine; Ren's childhood friend; track-team ace, top of her class, beautiful and popular; strapped into the cabinet as the Bride Candidate
木葉.register: Bright casual girlish (じゃん/〜なよ), teasing but devoted; in the ritual: halting, trailing commas and soft particles; four distinct ending personas (Normal/Rebellion/Ahe/Void)
木葉.note: speaker x125; full name 夏凪木葉 = Natsunagi Konoha

夏凪.role: Konoha's family name as shown in the dialogue UI name-box
夏凪.note: render the name-box as 'Natsunagi' or 'Konoha' consistently — prefer 'Konoha'

GM.role: Game master on the chapel monitor; voice of the Erotic Plasma Order / NightDance Inc.; runs the Bride Candidate selection ritual
GM.register: Polite-condescending lecturer (〜たまえ/〜かね/である); cult scripture dressed as neuroscience; calls Ren 蓮君, calls Konoha 花嫁候補 or 木葉さん; never crude, always clinical even when proposing the obscene
GM.note: speaker x158; keep the box as 'GM'

校長.role: New school principal installed by the company that took over the school; drugs the pair with chocolate; cult agent
校長.register: Drained, eerie, over-polite ですよ; speaks in riddles about 'awakening' and 'brides'

先生.role: Classroom teacher lecturing Erotic Plasma Order doctrine as normal exam material

？？？.role: Pre-reveal name-box: Konoha on the rooftop (x3) and the Principal's first line (x1)

斉藤.role: Baseball-club student in the chapel ghost rumor (mentioned only)
